primary.notes: The existing Neon project endpoint. All writes and every path not listed in readSplit.readPaths lands here.

replicas.notes: Neon read-only branch + read_only endpoint (terraform/neon-multiregion.tf). Same region as the primary — read scaling inside eu.
PLACEHOLDER — separate regional PostgreSQL fed by Neon logical replication (pgoutput). NOT provisioned by Terraform here; see domain/neon/README.md.

notes: HONEST LIMITATION: Neon has no native cross-region replication. The eu replica is a real Neon branch + read_only endpoint; us/asia replicas are separate regional PostgreSQL instances fed by Neon logical replication (pgoutput) — placeholders until those instances exist.

Integration point: the future read-router consumes DATABASE_READ_REPLICA_URLS (env var, documented) — NOT wired into the protected backend in FAZA 22. The backend, its schema, FTS and sharding stay untouched.
failoverOrder applies to READ path election only; the write primary stays the Neon eu project (single-writer).
readSplit.writePaths is an explicit allowlist for the primary — anything not in readPaths is treated as a write and routed to the primary by default.
